# aidial_file_translator (Data Source)

Reads a translator defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration. Translators stored in resource storage are read by `aidial_translator`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A translator defined in DIAL Core's static (file) configuration.
data "aidial_file_translator" "claude" {
  name = "openai-to-claude"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the translator in DIAL Core's static configuration.

### Read-Only

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the translator service.
- `in` (String) Incoming interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
- `out` (String) Outgoing interface type. One of `openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`.
